يفتضح (form VIII)
# يَفْتَضِحُ (yaftaḍiḥu) /jaf.ta.dˤi.ħu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِفْتَضَحَ (iftaḍaḥa)
# يَفْتَضِحَ (yaftaḍiḥa) /jaf.ta.dˤi.ħa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَضَحَ (iftaḍaḥa)
# يَفْتَضِحْ (yaftaḍiḥ) /jaf.ta.dˤiħ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِفْتَضَحَ (iftaḍaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
